text:
release-coordinator: starting staged rollout v2026.3 to eu1, 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. deploy-bot initiating canary checks.
deploy-bot: canary launched on pool-eu1-rc1. enabled probes: kv-prefill, heartbeat, embed-route. posting probe summary every 60s.
maria: early kv-prefill noise at 10% — intermittent 503s followed by quick recoveries. logs: [14:02:09Z] probe /_probe/kv -> 200; [14:02:10Z] -> 503; [14:02:11Z] -> 200. looks like retry amplification.
sre-jake: agree. retries at 0.5s are amplifying transient blips. suggest debounce/backoff increase and short warmup grace.
release-coordinator: proposal: debounce_backoff=2s, synth_initial_grace=15s. pause rollout at 10%, apply config, restart synth agents, then resume. decisions?
ash: +1 for pause+patch. otherwise we risk false positive pin or rollback.
karen: can apply synth-config as a staged config via deploy-bot. recommend documenting in release notes and runbook entry.
deploy-bot: command received: pause-rollout v2026.3 at 10%. applying synth-config v1.0.1 (debounce_backoff=2s, initial_grace=15s). restarting synth-agent on canary hosts.
(approximately 45s)
deploy-bot: synth-agent restart complete. first probe pass after restart: kv-prefill p95=145ms, heartbeat p95=90ms, embed p95=175ms. probe-failure-rate (5m) = 0.6%.
maria: noise suppressed, no retry storms. looks stable.
sre-jake: resume to 50% and monitor 10m window. alert thresholds: probe-fail > 2% or p95 > +20% vs baseline. if triggered, pin to v2026.2.
release-coordinator: resuming to 50% now. everyone monitor. :thumbsup:
karen: adding note to release notes: "Applied synth debounce and warmup grace to reduce probe noise during canary warmup." also added runbook tip: if noise returns, bump initial_grace to 30s.
nash: watching traces and KV warmup patterns. will escalate if tail latency persists.
sre-jake: thanks team. keeping watch until rollout completes.
release-coordinator: closing thread unless new anomalies appear.
